title: Stalker Tailgates Unmarked Police Car, Doesn’t End Well
description:
An Onalaska man was pulled over by an unmarked police car for tailgating. It was later discovered he had violated a domestic-abuse injunction against a woman. He denied stalking the woman, claiming he didn’t know where she lived, and drives through the area near her house to go to a nearby park, where he reads in his vehicle. 

Inderberg was charged with stalking, possession of meth, possession of drug paraphernalia and knowingly violating a domestic-abuse injunction, all as a repeat offender.
